claims.text: Every visit: age-appropriate exam, with an infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.
claims.quote: At each visit, age-appropriate physical examination is essential, with infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.

claims.text: Measure and plot on appropriate WHO Growth Chart: recumbent length; weight; head circumference; weight-for-length.
